subtitle: Dweba ilophu eyodwa evaliwe
short_description: Dweba ilophu eyodwa evaliwe eyanelisa zonke izimpawu zamaphethelo.
description:
Dweba ilophu eyodwa evaliwe emigqeni yegridi engahlukani futhi ingazigqumi. Isikwele ngasinye esinenombolo sikutshela ukuthi ilophu lisebenzisa imiphetho emingaki kwezine zaso.

Thepha isikwele, bese ucindezela enye yezinkinobho ezine ezinkulu – Phezulu, Ngakwesokudla, Phansi noma Ngakwesobunxele – ukuze wengeze noma ususe leyo mphetho.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
